build_dataset_from_directory: build a tfds DatasetBuilder from a generated dataset directory without requiring original generation code
build_dataset_from_multiple_dirs: build a tfds DatasetBuilder that reads from multiple dataset directories with the same features
build_dataset_from_metadata: build a tfds DatasetBuilder from a directory and an explicit DatasetInfo proto overriding directory metadata
build_dataset_from_files: build a tfds DatasetBuilder by auto-inferring the dataset location from name and builder kwargs
find_builder_dir: find the builder directory for a dataset name across registered data directories with version and config matching
